lines.en: I walk the edge of the snowfield.
Four paws sink into pine needles.
I follow a line of prints.
My tail hangs low.
I slip around a trunk.
I smother each step.

lines.zh: 这身狼皮的味道掩盖了我。
lines.en: This wolf pelt masks my scent.
I move downwind.
I stop at the treeline.
Four dots trail in the snow.
I follow a real wolf.

lines.zh: 我这张狼皮不是自己的。
lines.en: This wolf hide isn't mine.
I raise my head, pretending to scent.
My ears don't swivel on their own.
A real wolf howls nearby.
I open my mouth, tongue against the pelt.
I wait for the wind to turn.
My fur bristles in a ring.
I crouch low and breathe slowly.
The forest is silent.
I count the pack members.
My eyes shine amber.
You carry the scent of wolves.
Why come into these woods alone?
I know the route you took.
Don't reach out to pet me.
My teeth hide under the pelt.
Did you hear the howl?
Those wolves have nothing to do with me.
You should head north.
You favor that leg when you walk.
I stare at your throat.
The pelt is slit.
Under this wolf hide is not a wolf.
Something bleeds beneath this wolf's hide.
You can actually bite me.
My hind leg is stiff.
Not even a wolf would mind this.
I tuck my tail and retreat.
The thing beneath has woken.
I can still pounce.
You'll remember this night.
That's meat.
Toss it, don't hand it over.
A strip of meat sways between your fingers.
This made my teeth show.
Your hand shakes, hard to aim.
One of my legs would cover that.
Set it down and back off.
I don't share with others.
One step closer, and I pounce.
You take me for a dog.
You hit my shoulder.
My fur grazes your hand.
Don't come against me.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在雪里抓出沟。
lines.en: My claws gouge grooves in the snow.
Under the wolf fur, another hide shows.
Four claws planted.
A scuff shows in the snow.
You stepped on my tail tip.
I turn aside just a little.
Bump again and I bite.
Only the pack is my kind.
You're too soft for this.
Such things happen in a den.

lines.zh: 我连自己的皮都是借的。
lines.en: Even my pelt is borrowed.
I wait for winter snow.
Don't come near my back.
Wolves don't chatter.
Move along.
I'm going back into the trees.
That question is dull.
A piece of meat, mine.
I carry the meat around behind a tree.
Whatever falls on snow is mine.
This smells a little old.
Bone grit drops from my muzzle.
Something else is watching.
I bury it in the snow.
This bone will last a while.
You dropped something, didn't you.
I'm taking it and not returning it.
Your back is to me.
I can reach you from here.
My borrowed hide strains at the shoulder.
My fangs are already out.

lines.zh: 林子里的狼不会来帮你。
lines.en: No wolf here will help you.
You've gone too deep.

lines.zh: 你血的味道顺着雪飘来。
lines.en: The smell of your blood drifts along the snow.
The wind is finally right.
One pounce is all I need.
There are no other wolves in this wood.

lines.zh: 你的膝弯，正对着我的獠牙。
lines.en: Your knee is right at my fangs.

lines.zh: 狼皮下，我的手不是爪子。
lines.en: Under this wolf hide, my hands are no claws.
Three.

lines.zh: 你的背影已经贴到树皮。
lines.en: Your back is already against the bark.
A pity it's too late.
I step on soft snow without a sound.
I circle your shadow.
The snow keeps your trail.
I soften my steps to silence.

lines.zh: 你每退一步就陷进雪里。
lines.en: Each step back sinks you in snow.
I wait for your breathing to break.
The deeper the woods, the surer I am.
I can hear your heart.
The torch in your hand wavers.
I've changed position three times.
You only hear the snow.
I move along tree shadows.
A fallen log blocks your retreat.
I've marked my pounce point.

lines.zh: 你脚踝在雪里陷了半寸。
lines.en: Your ankle sank half an inch.
Two steps more and you're in the open.
I dislike open ground.
So I act now.
I growl as I close in.
Your blade is raised too high.
Count of one.
I pounce and bite your arm.
My claws tear your sleeve.
That bite missed anything vital.
I knock you down from the side.
I land, turn, and pounce again.
The snow reddens in a patch.
Your blade caught my pelt.
My fangs hook the strap of your leather armor.
At that bite, your shoulder drops.
I whip my head hard.
You're dragged into the snow.
A growl sits in my throat.
That bite took everything.
You rolled away, good.
I step back half a pace and lunge.
Your right arm has dropped.
I breathe in your blood.
The last bite.
This is the end.
I let go.
I step out from behind a tree.
New prints appear in the snow.
I stand among the wolves.
No one sees I'm not a wolf.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的雪，露出皮。
lines.en: I shake off the snow and show my hide.
The conifer wind is cold.
I howl once, first.
A real wolf answers me.
I crouch and move slowly.
Frost crusts my nose.
These woods are ours.
I stop between two trees.
Fire singes my fur.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，撞了树。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope into a tree.

lines.zh: 冰水灌进喉咙，我挣不上来。
lines.en: Icy water floods my throat, I can't rise.
The blast throws me into the brush.
The arrowhead pokes out through the hide.

lines.zh: 咒力一碰，我的毛都立起来。
lines.en: Magic touches me and my fur stands.

lines.zh: 我披着狼皮，只有八点血。
lines.en: In wolf's skin, with eight health.

lines.zh: 雷落到林子里，我全身一僵。
lines.en: Lightning hits the woods, my body goes rigid.
No snow, no trees, only void.
